rules: one Android endpoint; live peer IPC changes never replace other peers
one unique lease per key; repeated enrollment is idempotent and cannot rename or reactivate a disabled peer
only Android can activate, disable or revoke a peer
revocation removes the WireGuard key and blocks reenrollment for this session
revoked leases are reusable only after old flow reservations drain
capacity counts all authorized records, including disabled/offline clients
presence follows peer-presence.json; authorization and historical handshakes alone never prove current connectivity
changing the Android capacity setting requires stopping sharing
